scope: Local isolated fixtures only. No production hosts, accounts, credentials, Agent services, or model requests were used.

runtime.command: cd runtime && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/managed-machines.test.ts test/machine-ssh.test.ts test/machine-terminal.test.ts test/machine-ssh-live.test.ts
checks: managed machines validate host input and never return credential secrets
password credentials are short lived and cannot start automatic deployment
manual script credentials cannot be mistaken for automatic SSH deployment
credential decryption failure closes a deployment as failed
failed SSH deployment cancels the one-time enrollment token
deployment plan requires host pinning and apply keeps tokens out of command/output
AI preflight really calls SSH, saves an auditable result and creates the exact reviewable plan
SSH tools and HTTP reject members and arbitrary host/command/secret parameters
SSH login success with missing prerequisites is not an installable host; raw output is never returned
preflight errors and malformed host output return fixed codes without leaking secrets
multiple, revoked, expired, cross-host and unsupported SSH credentials never connect
checks and plans bind target, architecture, credential and expiry before enrollment issuance
in-flight check is exclusive per host and cancellation releases its lock
host key pin matches the exact key even when another algorithm appears first
fixed preflight executes valid POSIX shell and returns only bounded enum/boolean values
preflight rejects duplicates, arbitrary text, inconsistent statuses and credential-bearing platform URLs
terminal REST and upgrades enforce administrator, exact login, origin, owner, machine and single use
pending expiry, caps, ambiguous/expired/revoked keys and revocation release leases
real PTY: UTF-8, commands, Ctrl+C, resize, flow control, single attach, disconnect and revocation
real SSH validates host pin and auth, and cleans up on invalid protocol, logout, expiry, exit and shutdown
real terminal pauses output without ACK and closes idle sessions
global cap and cancelled pending entry release the exclusive host lease
real terminal total time limit closes an active connection and allows reconnect
SSH connection deadline closes a nonresponsive peer without retaining a lock
real SSH handshake, exact host pin, private-key authentication, timeout and cancellation
runtime.real_ssh: Disposable loopback sshd, temporary generated keys, actual OpenSSH and ssh2 connections, actual PTY commands. No user SSH configuration was used.
runtime.installation_boundary: The managed-machine installation success and failure paths use a mock SSH runner and mock enrollment receipts. This is not evidence of a real Agent installation.

browser_before_display_fix.fixture: All requests intercepted against isolated production frontend bundle; no remote machine or credentials are accessed.
checks: Connected SSH with missing prerequisites does not propose or install
Pinned host-key failure is explained
Standalone successful SSH preflight
In-flight preflight can be cancelled without a late result reopening the dialog
Deployment form detects architecture and saves a plan without applying
Deep link reviews and confirms the same persisted plan exactly once
Failed installation refreshes its real status and removes the obsolete approval action
Expired plans cannot be confirmed in the UI
English preflight and saved-plan steps are localized
Assistant tool result links to its exact persisted installation plan
Members cannot load host data or SSH actions

display_changes: The host address copy control copies the displayed address:port instead of the platform machine ID.
Chinese and English credential hints distinguish validity/expiration from deleting stored ciphertext and retain recommendations against long-term storage and to revoke credentials after use.

browser_after_display_fix.fixture: Updated local production bundle, all browser requests intercepted, no production state or secrets accessed.

browser_after_display_fix.verification_detail: The address control was clicked in a real headless Chromium page and navigator.clipboard.readText() returned host.example.com:22. Chinese and English warnings and validity field labels were asserted visible.
browser_after_display_fix.test_harness_note: An initial supplementary run timed out while looking for the English Close name in the Chinese modal; the selector was corrected to the modal close control before the successful 14-check run. No product error or unexpected request was observed.

limitations: Production validation is tracked separately; this report does not establish production SSH connectivity or reverse-proxy WebSocket behavior.
The frontend lacks machine editing and deletion controls although corresponding backend APIs exist; this is outside the scoped display fixes.
No backend credential persistence or purge behavior was changed.
